rules.identity: treeID and branchId are semantic identities; geometry never defines identity.
rules.rootFirst: Every tree begins with authoritative root truth before geometry is designed.
rules.branchPurpose: Every branch is a real integration with purpose, UI payload, expansion space, connection ownership, and verification.
rules.recursiveDepth: Branches may contain branches and must not be constrained to a fixed depth.
rules.adaptiveGeometry: Geometry is derived from semantic and UI payload; no universal branch height, radius, spacing, or position is assumed.
rules.expansionSpace: Every expanding division reserves clearance for adjacent divisions, wiring corridors, workspace visibility, and camera travel.
rules.maximumExpansion: The Hero maximum expansion state is derived from the combined footprint of participating divisions and their payload.
rules.turnLoopExpansion: Participating tree and branch divisions are active/open during the final turn-loop so semantic wiring paths can be traversed.
rules.electricalFlow: Turn-loop electricity follows actual semantic connection paths toward the workspace center.
rules.smoothExpansion: Division opening and closing must use smooth stateful choreography and must not be an instant visibility or coordinate swap.
rules.timingStatus: Current prototype timings are living implementation baselines, not final animation law.
rules.presentationBoundary: 3D tree presentation never grants entitlement, authorization, or durable domain authority.

heroComplete.requires: all required trees complete plus integrated camera, wiring, turn-loop, and acceptance evidence

completion.c9BlockedUntil: tree and branch structure is proven complete and integrated turn-loop layer is proven according to the active contract
